preconditions.description: The input contains at least one line (the number of test cases).

preconditions.expression: all(s.strip() == s and all(c in 'ABC' for c in s) and 1 <= len(s) <= 50 for s in stdin.strip().splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each test case string consists only of 'A', 'B', 'C' and has length between 1 and 50.
The first line integer t equals the number of subsequent test case lines.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly one line per test case.

postconditions.expression: all((ans.strip().upper() == 'YES' and (s.count('A') == s.count('C') and s.count('B') == s.count('A') + s.count('C'))) or (ans.strip().upper() == 'NO' and not (s.count('A') == s.count('C') and s.count('B') == s.count('A') + s.count('C'))) for ans, s in zip(stdout.strip().splitlines(), stdin.strip().splitlines()[1:]))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is 'YES' if and only if the count of 'B' equals the sum of counts of 'A' and 'C', and the counts of 'A' and 'C' are equal; otherwise it is 'NO'.
